content.user_title: Manage SoftSync Connections and App Access
content.value_statement: Pending approvals, incomplete setup, and unclear sharing can interrupt work across connected apps. This skill guides SoftSync connection checks, access management, and supported actions.
actual_capabilities: List accessible connections and distinguish active, pending, and incomplete states.
Recheck pending approvals and inspect setup progress.
Inspect access and guide owner-only changes for individual, selected teammate, or workspace access.
Discover supported app actions and their required details.
Run supported actions, with human approval required for changes in the outside app.
Inspect workflow impact before disconnecting an account.
limitations: Requires the SoftSync connections and manage_connections tools; this skill does not supply their implementation.
Initial connection requires signing in through the outside app.
Only active connections can run actions, and only the connection owner can change sharing.
Disconnecting cannot be undone; signing in again creates a new connection.

use_cases.title: Resolve an unfinished connection
use_cases.description: Check whether a connection awaits approval or needs more setup, then identify the next step.

use_cases.title: Share an account with selected colleagues
use_cases.description: Review account access and update sharing for selected teammates when you own the connection.

use_cases.title: Retrieve information from a connected app
use_cases.description: Find an active accounting connection, discover supported actions, and request an invoice lookup when available.

prompt_templates.title: List my connections
prompt_templates.prompt: List the connections I can use and show whether each is active, pending, or incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a pending connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether [connection] has received approval. If setup remains incomplete, show its progress and the next required step.

prompt_templates.title: Review and update sharing
prompt_templates.prompt: Show who can use [connection]. If I own it, share it only with [teammates], keeping workspace-wide access disabled.

prompt_templates.title: Review a planned disconnection
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the disconnect impact for [connection] and list affected workflows. Explain what reconnection means, then wait for my confirmation before disconnecting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess an irreversible connection change.

output_examples.input: Illustrative example: Why can I not use my accounting connection?
output: The outside app has not approved this connection yet.
Actions cannot run until the connection is active.

output_examples.input: Illustrative example: Review the impact before disconnecting my mailbox.
output: Disconnecting would stop this workflow from using the mailbox.
Disconnecting cannot be undone. Connecting again creates a new connection.

best_practices: Check connection status and resolve pending approvals or incomplete setup before running actions.
Share accounts only with the intended teammates and review the consequences of workspace-wide access.
Review affected workflows before disconnecting and obtain confirmation for the irreversible change.
anti_patterns: Attempting actions on pending or incomplete connections.
Opening an account to the whole workspace without reviewing who gains access.
Disconnecting without inspecting workflow impact or assuming reconnection restores the original connection.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It guides SoftSync tools for connection status, setup progress, sharing, supported app actions, and disconnection impact.

faq.question: Can it create the initial connection without signing in?
faq.answer: No. Initial connection requires signing in through the outside app.

faq.question: Why can a pending connection not run actions?
faq.answer: Pending connections await approval. Only active connections can be used; the check action asks the outside app for updated approval status.

faq.question: Who can change connection sharing?
faq.answer: Only the person who connected the account can change sharing. Workspace-wide access allows every workspace member to use that account.

faq.question: Do actions that change the outside app need approval?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states that actions changing the outside app wait for a person to approve them in the app.

faq.question: Can I undo a disconnection?
faq.answer: No. Review workflow impact first. Connecting again creates a new connection rather than restoring the original one.
